texts: The app that shows its workon every number.

sections.name: Food Suggestions
texts: The 3D food icons are interactable and hovering over them shows which food you should probably eat. That’s what the app will do for you.

sections.name: Meal Deconstruct
texts: The oil you can’t see still counts.
A photo cannot show every ingredient. CŌR asks about hidden oil, butter, sauce or cheese, and lets you choose a portion size before estimating your meal. Review and edit the result before logging it.

sections.name: Frequently Asked Questions
texts: The things people ask before they download.

features.title: Know your plan before signing in.
features.description: Answer setup questions to see suggested calorie and macro targets and a goal timeline. Review the plan first; sign in when you want to keep it.

features.title: Log food how you have it.
features.description: Search food records, use CŌR Intelligence to refine a search, scan a recognized barcode or enter a meal yourself. CŌR Pro adds photo and text estimates, nutrition-label scans and restaurant menu scans; review and edit before saving.

features.title: See why CŌR grades a product.
features.description: Review ingredient findings and the reasons behind a grade. Nutrition, allergens and processing references appear separately when the source record includes them. The rubric evaluates the information available to CŌR.

features.title: Bring nutrition and training together.
features.description: Track daily calories, macros and water alongside workouts, weight and strength trends. Connect supported Apple Health data with permission and manage workouts on Apple Watch. CŌR Pro adds coaching and AI workout tools.

plans.name: Free

Food search, manual logging and recognized barcode lookup

faq.a: CŌR is coming soon for iPhone, with a companion Apple Watch app. This page shows features built into the current app. Download links will appear when access opens.

faq.q: Do I need an account to see my plan?
faq.a: No. You can answer the setup questions and review suggested targets and a goal timeline before signing in. Sign in when you want to keep and sync your plan.

faq.q: What can I use without CŌR Pro?
faq.a: The core app includes your plan and targets, food search, manual entries, recognized barcode lookup, calorie and macro tracking, workout logging, strength and weight progress, and supported Apple Health connections. CŌR Pro adds select AI-assisted features; the exact offer is shown in the app.

faq.q: How does CŌR Intelligence search work?
faq.a: It can refine a food search and show possible matches. Check the product, brand and serving before logging.
No. Photo and text results are estimates. Before a photo analysis, you can add hidden ingredients, choose a portion and leave a note. Review and edit the result before saving it to your day.

faq.q: How does a product grade work?
faq.a: CŌR applies its scoring rubric to the ingredient information it has and explains the findings. Nutrition, allergens and processing data are shown separately when available. If AI helps read a label, its confidence alone does not verify that label. A grade is for food comparison, not medical advice.

faq.q: Does CŌR’s daily score measure my health?
faq.a: No. It summarizes available logged nutrition, training, hydration and recovery data against your goals. Missing readings are not treated as measured results. It is a progress signal, not a diagnosis or overall health assessment.

faq.q: Does CŌR work with Apple Health and Apple Watch?
faq.a: With your permission, CŌR can connect supported Apple Health activity, sleep, body measurements and nutrition data. The companion Watch app can follow a workout, record sets and manage rest.

faq.q: What happens when I use an AI feature?
faq.a: CŌR asks for permission before sending content you choose to analyze, such as a meal photo, food description or menu image, to an external AI provider. Separate AI controls are available in the app. Manual logging does not require those AI analyses.
The final subscription price and any eligible trial will be shown in the app before you purchase. No launch price is being advertised on this page yet.
